desc: Combining the performance of a larger handgun with class-leading concealability and capacity, the new Hellcat Pro is a compact pistol that delivers the perfect balance. Chambered in 9mm, the Hellcat Pro offers 15+1 capacity in a smaller footprint than any other gun in its class. Optics ready and equipped with a versatile accessory rail, this exceptional everyday carry pistol combines compact dimensions with the performance capabilities of a full-sized pistol.
